authority: Human sponsor delegated unresolved product defaults to the engineering agent in this chat.
legalBoundary: These are conservative configurable product defaults. They do not replace jurisdiction-specific legal, privacy, clinical, security or audit approval, and a stricter applicable duty always overrides them.

externalModelOutputs.acceptedDisposition: retain human decision and non-content provenance under the patient-record schedule

offlinePackagesAndCaches.completionEvidence: authoritative device or provider attestation; app acknowledgement alone is insufficient

audit.completionEvidence: verified chain plus explicit sensitive-detail unavailability

exports.unmanagedCopyClaim: cryptographic erasure only; never claim physical deletion without authoritative destination evidence

hostedObjects.requiredCapability: exact versionId plus If-Match ETag deletion enforced by storage policy
hostedObjects.currentBehavior: fail closed until a real adapter and provider capability are verified

gateEffect: Resolves the product-default decision gap. It does not itself prove provider/device deletion, formal acceptance, QA_PASS, merge or deployment.
